verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Smithery CLI only for searching the registry, adding connections, and calling tools. Publishing is documented as a web flow where you enter a public HTTPS URL, with no CLI authentication, build, stage, or push commands. The vendor's own shutdown notice also says the Smithery CLI stopped working on October 31, 2026 and is deprecated, so no CLI-driven publish-and-deploy workflow is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents

citations.quote: smithery mcp add <url>                  # Add an MCP server connection
